inputs.xtext_rule_text:
fragment PackageBody returns SysML::Package :
	 ';' 
	| '{' ( // Note: PackageBodyElement is expanded here to avoid
			// infinite loops in the incremental parser.
		    ownedRelationship += PackageMember
		  | ownedRelationship += ElementFilterMember
		  | ownedRelationship += AliasMember
		  | ownedRelationship += Import )* 
	  '}'
;

decision: SysML 8.2.2.5.1 states PackageBody : Package = ';' | '{' PackageBodyElement* '}'. The SysML Xtext expands PackageBodyElement into PackageMember | ElementFilterMember | AliasMember | Import, and its own comment says this is 'to avoid infinite loops in the incremental parser' — an LL workaround, not ported. The rule is the clause as written.

evidence.note: inlined PackageBodyElement, commented as an incremental-parser workaround; declined

notes: The Xtext also returns SysML::Package here and SysML::Namespace in KerML; the pack's metaclass says Namespace. The result metaclass is not syntax.
